blocking_defects: Item 12: G19 silently suppresses root-traversal errors and reports successful coverage and absence of undeclared copies despite skipped subtrees. Observed 24 recoverable long-path traversal failures plus one access-denied subtree while G19 returned OK. No undeclared target copies were found in the recovered subtrees; the defect is the unsupported completeness claim.
notes: 20 PASS, 1 FAIL, 1 NOT_VERIFIABLE. No repairs or filesystem writes were performed. Python 3.12.14 ran with bytecode disabled; gate execution used a guard blocking writes and subprocess launch. G22's unrestricted selftest remains unverified. Guarded payload verdict was PASS, 12/13, zero blocking failures, one reporting finding, exit 0. Payload scope excludes G11, G13, G16a, G16b, G19, and G26; ordinary stdout does not announce those exclusions. Saved selftest now records G19 and G26 FIRED and G16b BASELINE_RED, as claimed; the full mutating selftest was not replayed. Registry signature presence, not cryptographic validity, was checked. Primary L0:310 expressly retains OWNER_SEMANTIC_ACK_HOLD when evidence is missing; that line alone does not expressly grant the issuance route attributed to it.
